sections.title: Block types
sections.body:
Reply in ordinary text. When a message needs typed content, embed a workspace block like this:

```workspace:<type>
{...one JSON object for the block value...}
```

Everything outside such fences is plain text. The workspace assigns block IDs; do not emit `id` or `key`.

Each payload is exactly one JSON object with the fields its type lists; unknown fields are rejected.

## BLOCK TYPES
- `document`: A titled document, inline text or a blob reference
  - inline: {"title": "...", "text": "..."}
  - blob: {"title": "...", "ref": "<blob id>", "media_type": "..."}
- `json`: Structured data, validated by a schema at the call site
  - the payload is any JSON object, e.g. {"items": [1, 2, 3]}
- `thinking`: A reasoning trace, kept for display
  - {"text": "...", "signature": "..."} (signature optional)

Only the types listed above may appear in a workspace fence. Never wrap tools in blocks; call tools through the provider's tool channel instead.
